_comment: Panel spec — presentation only; the graph cooks identically without it. See shared/graphUi.ts.

controls.label: iso value
controls.description: Where the surface sits in the field. For a signed distance it is a plain offset, so this grows and shrinks the rock without re-cutting anything — the same graph, one number.

controls.label: cell size
controls.description: Cube edge in world units, and EXACT rather than a request. Cost grows with its cube and every corner is a field evaluation, so halving it is eight times the work. It changes how finely the surface is resolved and never where the surface is.
